frozen_correction: optimized_balanced_fit_calibration correction weights, feature standardization, gain and input template unchanged
training: NLI train1700 native binary labels only
selection: Evaluate once on NLI dev200; advance only if correct >=148 (the previously frozen balanced dev score). No threshold search.
